answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the spiral queue naming the summit that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 11 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Because of that, each extra identity costs 11 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the lotus record shows exactly who is still on probation. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
